notes.title: Get the key to the game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305006/50cc9d9e7ddddfefe45a85a077f3ee8dac882256.jpg[/img]
The new VR game Westernlands: Girly runways story is coming soon!
We decided to give the key to everyone who can prank a student in our Bad Boy Simulator!

Conditions:
1. Start the BBS game
2. Implement a prank on a student that is tearing him up
3. Make a screen
4. Attach the screen in the discussion to this post

On June 15, we will check each participant and give a key to get into the atmosphere of the Wild West in the new VR game Westernlands: Girly runways story!
Ready? Then let's start!
